children.value: > Fact From Story The Steam Deck OLED is sharper and more responsive; indie games, AAA games and plain old Steam menus look so much better on the new hardware.
> > Fact From Story The Steam Deck OLED has a new Wi-Fi 6E radio and a dedicated Bluetooth module, which allows for improved audio quality with wireless headphones
> > > Fact From Story The OLED touchscreen responds immediately to input, and the haptic feedback on the built-in trackpads feels even more precise
> > > Fact From Story The thumbsticks on the new handheld have an improved texture that shouldn’t turn gray after a few months’ use, and they feel perfectly serviceable.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge More responsive touchscreens and better thumbsticks improve a device.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Faster Wifi and better bluetooth are improvements on a device.
> Commonsense Knowledge A sharper and more responsive device is better than one that is not.
